Overview

Santa Ana is a city in SA with a population of 280,000. El Salvador’s second city, a beautiful colonial city with a stunning Gothic cathedral and nearby coffee plantations. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
